items.text: Hey all!

This has been a long time coming, but this patch adds support for mouse sensitivity. You can adjust it by going to the Accessibility section of the options menu, and choose to use the default desktop mouse speed, or manually set your own speed.

items.text: Mouse Sensitivity setting
General optimizations and bug fixes
Baileya 12 buffed slightly

notes.title: Hey all, just some bug fixes

items.text: Baileya 12 now able to be deselected
Fixed a crash happening with the Abhorrence
Fixed Cain .50 not displaying as a rifle in the Nun’s menu
Fixed turret bullets sometimes not spawning in correctly
Fixed bullets not colliding correctly when shooting vertically while pressed up against a wall
Fixed exhilaration bottle liquid looking bugged
Fixed issue where enemy attributes wouldn’t stack properly
Ehiztaria sword beam now correctly hits the player
Fixed issue where players wouldn’t be able to find misplaced chambers

The last point there is probably the biggest fix. Misplaced chambers will now appear, and probably at a pretty decent rate. You're guaranteed to see at least one per run and will probably encounter multiple.

notes.title: Get ready to play new content in OTXO!

items.text: Hey all!

To start, I never truly planned on releasing any sort of content updates. But the game has done better than I thought it might and the community response has been honestly overwhelming, so I wanted to do something to thank everyone for playing the game and enjoying it as much as you have. This update will be the only ever content update for the game, just a thank-you gift to the fans. I appreciate ya'll!

If you've beaten the game, you'll find a new NPC on the beach who offers you run modifiers. There's 6 of these modifiers, and if you complete a run with a modifier on, you'll unlock a brand new gun and a brand new drink that can start appearing in the shop. 6 modifiers, 6 guns, 6 drinks. 666.
These modifiers are designed to be tricky and change the way you approach the game, be it in terms of handling enemies or spending coin. Some are certainly going to be trickier than others!

notes.title: This update also contains a good number of bug fixes

items.text: Lowered sound volume of Lateralis Heavy Industries logo animation by 8 db (sorry)
Fixed player speed stacking/slowing with certain abilities
Fixed M2 Dendrocnide showing incorrect damage numbers in the armory menu
The sniper rifle now correctly destroys explosive barrels
The song over the credits now stops correctly when the credits are skipped
Fixed issue with French translation not displaying a text character

Various other minor fixes: I've also made it so you're guaranteed to find at least one Misplaced Chamber per run. Most likely it will come later in a run, so hopefully you've been able to save up some coin at that point.: A while back Steam Cloud saving was added, and recently the game was also Steam Deck verified, which is cool.: Also, I'm pleased to announce OTXO's soundtrack is now also available on Steam! You can grab it in a bundle with the game if you'd like.: I'd like to take a moment to thank everyone for playing and enjoying the game. I put a lot of work into it and it's very gratifying to see that effort appreciated on the other side. This update is for you! Thanks :)
Nate

Hey all!

Thanks for playing and enjoying the game so far (and leaving reviews, I really appreciate those). This patch contains mostly bug fixes with a small amount of balance changes, mostly related to how finding Misplaced Chambers works.
Vsync toggle now available.
Misplaced Chambers now have a higher chance of appearing the longer you've gone without seeing one.
Credits can now be skipped by pressing the Interact button or Enter.
Intro logo sounds are now tied to sound volume
Fixed laundry room Misplaced Chamber having considerable lag
Fixed explosion damage not affecting the player properly
Fixed Gunboot bullets when combined with Homing Pigeon so they no longer provide infinite ammo for your gun
Fixed rebinding alt/ctrl being "undefined" in the options menu
Fixed Sober achievment unlocking even though players had taken drinks that run
Fixed El Cycle ability being overridden by the reload animation of some shotguns
Fixed issue where if you have the setting enabled for music to not go into slowmo during Focus, it would bug out after finishing a level and play in slowmo for the next level
Fixed error occurring in the tutorial
Fixed an issue where starting a new run with a current Impossible Mode save would put you into another Impossible Mode run.
Fixed issue where pausing while Deabrua had pentagrams on the ground would cause their sound to continue playing.
Fixed an issue where fishing while holding a stick would break the player sprite.
Many Doors drink has a higher chance of finding a Misplaced Chamber now.

A note on Steam Deck verification: I did some research and it turns out that Steam is slowly rolling out this option to developers, so currently I don't have the option to apply for verification, and will just have to wait on Steam. However, I viewed the requirements and the game absolutely passes Steam Deck verification (plus we've heard from all the Steam Deck players that it runs perfectly).
Cloud Saving: This is next on my agenda and something I'm looking into! Hopefully by next patch I'll have that sorted.

Once again, thank you all for playing and enjoying the game so far. If you haven't left a review, please do so, it helps a lot! If we can get over 500 reviews we have a shot at an Overwhelmingly Positive rating, which would be excellent. But regardless, thank you all, genuinely.

topNew: Misplaced Chambers now have a higher chance of appearing the longer you've gone without seeing one.
Credits can now be skipped by pressing the Interact button or Enter.

notes.title: Just a few small bug fixes here, but also an important one

items.text: If you, before starting the game for the first time, changed your language or went into the options, your save now has a problem where it believes you've unlocked everything. You'll know if you're affected by this if you opened the game and immediately got the two achievements Collector and Investor.

Unfortunately, the only way to fix this is to delete your save. Fortunately, you shouldn't have anything unlocked because it wouldn't let you (at least for the girl at the bar, not sure about gachapon machines). I'm truly sorry for this, this is one of those kind of bugs that just slips by. I'm glad I'm catching it Day 1 at least so the continued life of the game is fine for most players.

To delete your save, go to your local app data and delete your OTXO folder. Hit Windows Key + R, type in %appdata&, navigate back to your Local folder (it might have taken you to your roaming folder), and delete your OTXO_Release folder. Then restart the game. You'll have to do the tutorial again, but like I said, this will fix the issue and you will be able to enjoy the unlockables.
Once again, I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. This should solve it going forward, and as usual, feel free to let me know if you run into any bugs.
